name: solana-memecoin-bot-mobile
description: Android control UI for the paper Solana memecoin bot (no wallet keys)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.postinstall: echo "Run: npm run build && npx cap add android (first time) then npm run cap:sync"
